verification.method: worth probe, NOT solve_band -- see below
verification.methodNote: solve_band minimises the error of the finished stack, which slides a layer to the least-bad spot when it does not belong in the window at all: it walked three layers here to their window edges and left the band at 3.03. Maximising WORTH instead -- err(absent) - err(present), both measured over the SAME box -- placed every layer. The method validates itself on 2610:119, whose x is independently proven by the left-edge clip: the worth probe returns exactly that x.
